name: io.github.ashlrai/lexicon
title: Lexicon
description: Fixes the names and jargon speech-to-text gets wrong before your agent acts on a dictated prompt.

packageArguments.description: Runs the stdio MCP server. The package also installs a dedicated `lexicon-mcp` binary; `lexicon mcp` is used here because npx resolves the package-named `lexicon` bin by default.

environmentVariables.name: LEXICON_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the global lexicon YAML. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lexicon/lexicon.yaml, else ~/.config/lexicon/lexicon.yaml.

environmentVariables.name: LEXICON_CWD
environmentVariables.description: Directory used to locate the project .lexicon.yaml. Defaults to the server process working directory.
